implementation.transport: Intra CLI -> Unix Socket -> NativeHost -> Chrome extension; business HTTP was not reached

observations.reason: Snapshot validation failed before credential store access

sourceAnalysis.confirmedDefect: The extension requests only service-subdomain host permissions. Chrome cookies.getAll additionally checks the cookie's own domain and Secure-derived scheme. Parent-domain .corp.example cookies are filtered out without matching parent-origin permissions.
sourceAnalysis.cookieDomainEvidence: Historical sso.corp.example cookie metadata uses domain .corp.example; not proof of the current browser login state.
sourceAnalysis.uncertainty: Zero matches do not establish that the user is logged out or that adding permission alone will make the request succeed. Re-test after the user reloads and grants the updated optional permissions.

remediation.authorizationScope: corp.example and its subdomains, explicitly selected by the user
remediation.cookieSelection: Explicit names from the registered service and cookies applicable to the requested URL; no global cookie header or cross-site cache merge
